name: Givon AI
original_description:
Turn your ideas and reference images into images, videos, music and voiceovers — right in ChatGPT. Describe what you want in your own words or attach a reference, and Givon helps you create the finished content.

With Givon, you can:
• Create product photos, advertising visuals and marketplace listing images.
• Animate photos and generate short videos.
• Create music and voiceovers for your videos.
• Reuse saved Givon media in new generations.

Connect your Givon account to get started.
